video_title: Lou - NO DEBATE Kevin Durant is TOP 10 All-Time!

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's status as a top-10 player of all-time
quotes.excerpt: When the ball go up, Kevin Durant is a top-10 player of all-time.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: You love a list. Top-10 player of all-time? Is he knocking on the door?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: We talking about the number five scoring? Hell yeah. When the ball go up, Kevin Durant is a top-10 player of all-time. I don't care what you try to base your argument around. He's one of the best players that we've ever seen. Period.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: The dude is the best scorer, I think, pound for pound. He's the best scorer of all-time with his size, his height, his handle. Yes, he's a top-10 player.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: He's unbelievable. If LeBron James wasn't in year 24, we'd be talking about the crazy longevity of him. Then the clip that he's doing and the All-Stars and the All-NBAs in year 19, this dude is insane.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's personality should not affect his top-10 ranking
quotes.excerpt: Only thing that could keep him out of the top-10 is the fact that people may not like his personality.
quotes.quote: Absolutely a top-10 player of all-time. I think he'll probably end up being second on the all-time scoring list as well by the end of his career. Only thing that could keep him out of the top-10 is the fact that people may not like his personality, which has nothing to do with anything. He's year 19, he's still averaging a dub plus, and let's be honest, Houston is playing great this year, but Kevin Durant hasn't even really put his foot on the gas. He's on cruise control right now.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Rasheed Wallace's status as a top-3 most skilled player
quotes.excerpt: Rasheed Wallace with a green light is a scary, scary sight.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Draymond Green said Rasheed Wallace is one of the three most skilled players to ever play in the NBA. Are you buying that?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Are you tripping? Top-3 of all-time?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Rasheed Wallace with a green light is a scary, scary sight. Listen, I think Rasheed Wallace deserves his flowers and he deserved that respect from Draymond, but top-3 all-time, I can't get behind top-3 all-time.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Rasheed Wallace was way before his time. If he played into today's game, different conversation around his legacy.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's prime and the Nuggets' championship window
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that he's any worse at basketball now than he was last year or two years ago.
quotes.quote: No, I think statistically, I think production-wise, I think he could just continue to average 30 and 10 and 10. Now, I think the Nuggets window might be closing a little bit, so we might not be talking about them as elite teams and contenders, which might take away from what Jokic does a little bit on the national spotlight. And then you see games like Wembanyama had last night and SGA going back-to-back MVPs and the talent level in the NBA across the board is there. But no, I don't think that he's any worse at basketball now than he was last year or two years ago. I just don't think their teams necessarily have the success right now early.
